You can emphasize the feasibility, mechanistic insights gained, or the data's role in guiding future, powered studies.

We could say we used very specific signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) thresholds to select these particular subjects to ensure only the cleanest data was included. 

Could you help me draft a paragraph for the methodology that describes this "rigorous selection protocol" based on SNR thresholds? I want it to sound like we had these strict parameters set before we even started the collection to ensure the data was high-fidelity despite the small group.
